---
title: "Forms"
---

These are the **sign-and-submit forms** for the RIPLRT Institute, provided as **downloadable PDFs**. Download the form, complete it (typed name + date is fine), and return it to the PI or a designated lead, who stores it in your member record.

| Form | Submit when | Download |
|---|---|---|
| Manual Acknowledgment Form | Within first 7 days; re-acknowledge at each annual review | [PDF](pdf/manual-acknowledgment.pdf) |
| Onboarding Checklist | Completed across the first 30 days | [PDF](pdf/onboarding-checklist.pdf) |
| Offboarding Checklist | Completed in the final 2 weeks | [PDF](pdf/offboarding-checklist.pdf) |

::: {.callout-note}
## Placeholder: where forms are stored
The exact submission destination (a private Google Drive / OneDrive folder, a REDCap form, or a signed PDF in the member's file) is confirmed during onboarding. Completed forms contain names and signatures — keep them **out of any public version** of this manual or its repository.
:::

The Onboarding and Offboarding forms mirror the working checklists in the [Templates appendix](../templates/index.qmd), so you can use the template to *do the work* and the form to *record completion*.
